dcat_keyword_sm: Digital Data Information and Business Services Branch
dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes digital watershed boundaries of the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence Basin including:
  • The Lake Superior watershed
  • The Lake Huron watershed
  • The Lake Erie watershed
  • The Lake Ontario watershed
  • The St. Lawrence River watershed
This data was created to support the Ontario Water Resources Act (OWRA, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.40). For more information concerning the relationship of this data to the Act, please consult the 'Readme' text file contained in the download ZIP package.

Additional Documentation
  • Map showing the municipal structures and water basins (PDF)
  • Ontario Water Resources Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.40
